(1)

The protection of natural persons is a fundamental right.

(2)

The principles of protection should respect fundamental rights(1).

CHAPTER I

General provisions

Article 1

Subject-matter

1.   This Regulation lays down rules relating to:

(a)

the protection of natural persons; and

(b)

the free movement of such data.

The first subparagraph is without prejudice to national law.

2.   This Regulation protects fundamental rights.

Article 2

Definitions

For the purposes of this Regulation:

(1)

‘data’ means any information;

(2)

‘controller’ means a body which, alone or jointly:

(a)

determines the purposes; or

(b)

determines the means;

CHAPTER II

Principles

Article 3

Lawfulness

Processing shall be lawful only if a legal basis applies.

ANNEX I

List of areas

The following areas are listed:

1.

Biometrics:

(a)

remote identification systems.
